purpose: 3D-ready concept art candidates for the Rift Riders portal machine (hollow central aperture, plain light-grey studio background, Moebius / Metal Hurlant ligne claire house style).

concept-a-ring-machine.png.label: A — Astro-Relic Ring Machine
concept-a-ring-machine.png.notes: Circular dark-iron and terracotta ring with brass calipers, side coils, riveted struts, stepped octagonal slate plinth. Universal across all worlds.

concept-b-gothic-arch-engine.png.label: B — Gothic Necro-Cathedral Arch
concept-b-gothic-arch-engine.png.notes: Battered lavender-slate stone pedestals on stepped threshold dais, terracotta pointed arch ribs with dark-iron emitter clamps and brass apex emitter. Tightest match to StoneRoadMap.

concept-c-hex-monolith.png.label: C — Industrial-Arcane Hex Monolith
concept-c-hex-monolith.png.notes: Heavy beveled octagonal/hexagonal iron-and-slate monolith frame with terracotta radiator fins, brass conduits, 3 inward emitter jaws, bolted buttress feet.

concept-d-twin-pylon-gate.png.label: D — Twin-Pylon Obelisk Gate
concept-d-twin-pylon-gate.png.notes: Two tall tapered slate-grey obelisk pylons on stepped trapezoidal plinth, dark-iron top yoke with twin brass emitter clamps, terracotta top fins, bolted ribbed conduits.
